intro.promise: Every team gets frontier models and agents, and **nothing reaches a provider unchecked, unbudgeted or unrecorded**.

scenes.cap: Anyone can use frontier models, but every request first proves **who is asking** and what their role allows.

chat.t: Summarise this supplier contract and list the risks.

verdict.s: Policy, budget and ledger sit in front of every model.

scenes.cap: Budgets are checked **before the call, not after the bill**: alerts at 50, 80 and 100 percent, then a hard stop.
A **smart router** sends each request to the right tier and records the saving against always using Premium.
One gateway reaches **30 models from 11 providers**. People bring their own keys; platform keys stay hidden.
Every call writes a **ledger row**: tokens, time, cost and who paid, so spend is visible by team, person and model.

chat.t: **Three risks found:** auto-renewal, uncapped liability, a 90-day notice period.
